mapper.select: SELECT POST_ID AS postId , USER_ID AS userId , CATEGORY AS category , TITLE AS title , CONTENT AS content , VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount , IS_NOTICE AS isNotice , CREATE_DT AS createDt , UPDATE_DT AS updateDt , ( SELECT COUNT(cc.COMMENT_ID) FROM community_comment cc WHERE cc.POST_ID = cp.POST_ID ) AS commentCnt FROM community_post cp;
